title: Signal and Vector
author: Hazel Ravensworth
blurb: August Sandoval, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
